extends: training_batch_004b_capture_only_integration.json field 'orb_timing_context' (structured expansion of the SAME contract - not a competing schema); applies per XAU-F record from Cycle 006 onward
source_rule: ORB candidate spec, Visual Batch 2 (VISUAL_BATCH2_REPORT.md / register addendum visual_findings_batch2 VR-13): first 15-min session candle; H/mid/L; visuals suggest wick-extreme anchoring; no-trade-inside; close-beyond + structure break + retest; unretested-breakout and midpoint magnets; session choice and right-breakout judgement DISCRETIONARY; body-vs-wick verbal rule, breakout-close TF, retest depth, validity horizon UNKNOWN
v03_eligibility: PROHIBITED - no ORB field may become a v0.3 input, weight or threshold; forward-test evidence only

fields.orb_timezone: IANA tz or UTC-offset of the session-open convention used (his charts run GMT+1/GMT+2)
fields.orb_source_timeframe: candle TF used to construct the range (expected 15m) or UNKNOWN
fields.orb_anchor_basis: WICK_EXTREMES | BODY_EXTREMES | MIXED | UNKNOWN (visuals suggest WICK_EXTREMES; never inferred per-record)
fields.orb_break_close_confirmed: true | false | UNKNOWN (bar-close body close beyond the range)
fields.orb_break_close_timeframe: TF of the confirming close (5m/15m/...) or UNKNOWN
fields.orb_retest_depth: price distance into the range at retest, or UNKNOWN
fields.orb_unretested_magnet_claim: citable statement that an unretested orb level is a draw target (msg/video ref) or UNKNOWN
fields.orb_midpoint_magnet_claim: citable statement re the mid as internal magnet, or UNKNOWN
fields.orb_selected_over_other_session: true | false | UNKNOWN (e.g. 'I only marked the US orb')
fields.orb_validity_horizon: stated horizon or UNKNOWN (parameter UNKNOWN in the spec)
fields.orb_evidence_timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC of the evidence itself
fields.orb_evidence_classification: DIRECT_VISUAL_EVIDENCE | DIRECT_AUDIO_AND_VISUAL | SPOKEN_CLAIM | INDICATOR_PANEL | CROSS_ASSET_DEMONSTRATION | INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE | UNKNOWN
fields.orb_unknowns: list of parameters left UNKNOWN for this record (never silently filled)

hypothesis_record.name: orb_forward_hypothesis_status (capture-only, per qualifying XAU/Gold event)
hypothesis_record.rule: status derives from captured fields only; deterministic once OHLC imported; NEVER feeds v0.3

panel_version_guard: indicator-sourced orb values must record the visible indicator stack/version per FC-PANELWATCH; [kyle]-era displays are NOT current-panel equivalents; repaint status stays UNKNOWN unless demonstrated (F5 binding)
historical_backfill_policy: old records untouched; a backfill is allowed only where source evidence already exists and the record is explicitly marked HISTORICAL_BACKFILL
